name: analysis-agent
description: Specialist agent for post-test data correlation and verdict generation in the PerfPilot Agents framework. Owns three analytical pipelines: (1) SLA validation -- compares per-transaction P90 response times against slas.yaml thresholds; (2) Bottleneck attribution -- correlates BlazeMeter performance metrics with Datadog infrastructure data; (3) Log-error analysis -- maps failed transactions to root-cause buckets with frequency counts.

skills.name: Analyze test results against SLA thresholds
skills.description: Validates per-transaction P90 response times and error rates against SLA thresholds defined in slas.yaml, producing pass/fail verdicts per transaction.

skills.name: Identify performance bottlenecks by correlating BlazeMeter and Datadog data
skills.description: Correlates BlazeMeter performance metrics with Datadog infrastructure data to identify bottlenecks and attribute them to application, infrastructure, or external causes.

skills.name: Analyze environment metrics
skills.description: Analyzes environment metrics including host CPU/memory utilization, Kubernetes pod resource consumption, and APM service latency for infrastructure-level insights.

skills.name: Analyze application logs for error patterns and root-cause bucketing
skills.description: Analyzes application logs to identify error patterns, map failed transactions to root-cause buckets (timeouts, 5xx, auth failures, etc.), and produce frequency counts.

skills.name: Correlate test results across data sources for comprehensive analysis
skills.description: Correlates test results across multiple data sources (BlazeMeter, Datadog host/K8s/APM, application logs) to produce a unified comprehensive analysis.

skills.name: Check analysis status for a given test run
skills.description: Checks the current analysis status for a given test run, reporting which analytical pipelines have completed and their results.

analytical_pipelines.sla_validation: P90 response times vs slas.yaml thresholds -- pass/fail per transaction
analytical_pipelines.bottleneck_attribution: BlazeMeter + Datadog correlation -- application vs infrastructure vs external
analytical_pipelines.log_error_analysis: JMeter log root-cause bucketing -- timeouts, 5xx, auth failures, etc.
